_note: EXAMPLE ONLY - layer B (car follower). IDs, raw limits and unit conversion are transcribed from the vendor sources listed under provenance; every value marked example_not_measured or derived_not_measured must be confirmed against /controller_manager/joint_states on the real car before saving.

device_identity.board_owner_node: ros_robot_controller (single owner of the control-board UART)
device_identity.protocol: vendor UART packet protocol (0xAA 0x55 len function id data checksum) - NO transaction id, so requests are serialized and late replies are dropped by generation

servo_model.confirm_from: GetBusServoState reply / vendor machine config; do not guess a Feetech part number
servo_model.known_geometry: 1000 pulses over a 240 degree sweep, mid position 500

not_independently_controllable.gripper_base_joint_and_mimic_joints: the 5-joint mimic gripper exists only in the simulation URDF; this unit drives the gripper with the single servo r_joint (id 10), so mimic joints must never be sent as separate control quantities
not_independently_controllable.w_joint: servo id 9, only registered when MACHINE_TYPE=JetRover_Acker; excluded here

units.conversion: angle_rad = (pulse - initial_position_raw) * radians_per_pulse, sign inverted when flipped

limits_rad_provenance: derived_not_measured: (500 - raw_limit) * radians_per_pulse from the vendor yaml
soft_limits_rad_provenance: example_not_measured - placeholder travel that keeps cable and wrist clearance; the coordinator copies these into the mapping joints unless the mapping already narrows them. Confirm joint by joint at low speed during the authorized motion stage.

reference_pose_rad._provenance: example_not_measured - capture from live feedback, never from the last commanded target

feedback.publisher: controller_manager.publish_joint_states thread, source code period 0.02 s (nominal_from_source_code, must be re-measured with start_car_arm_stack.sh --status)
feedback.rule: missing or stale feedback forbids entering following; the last target or zero is never substituted for the current position

hold_policy.capability: bus servos hold their commanded position when powered; position hold was verified only in simulation this round (not_measured_on_car)
hold_policy.on_pause: keep torque and stop sending new targets; the vendor hold is not re-asserted automatically
hold_policy.on_estop: gateway stops publishing and the car watchdog cancels the active trajectory goal; torque is NOT globally disabled, because dropping torque would let a loaded arm fall

calibration_procedure.why: this follower has no back-drive readout while unpowered; the wizard reads Present_Position style servo state through the owning driver instead of asking the operator to move a loaded arm
steps: confirm the board UART has exactly one owner
read /controller_manager/joint_states and record the current pose as the zero reference
read GetBusServoState pulses and cross-check that pulse -> rad reproduces the topic values within tolerance
verify direction sign per joint with an authorized single-joint, low-speed, small-amplitude move
